title: draba incana var. arabisans
intro: Draba incana var. arabisans, commonly known as Alpine Rockcress, is a plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Rockcress include its ability to act as an antimicrobial agent, protect against oxidative damage, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
